steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oof... Ah.. That hurts a little...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial, you're awake! Are you okay?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I'm fine. Just a scratch.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: More importantly, is that the machine Zumama's been tinkering with all this time?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yes. I heard them calling it 'The Big, Ugly Thing.' So gross...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: It's pretty badass!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: So... Err, huh?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: But the big thing definitely beat you down...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I can tell it's really tough, even through it knocked my lights out before I got a good look at it.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Hmm, yes it is...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: But I never imagined she'd actually put together something like this.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Closure makes some weird gadgets every once in a while, yeah, but even she'd be impressed with Zumama's machine here. Haha.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Wow, are there lots of things like that at Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Waaaa! Rhodes Island sounds scary...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Haha, Rhodes Island would blow your little mind.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Haha, now that you mention it, that thing would drive Closure up the wall as soon as she laid eyes on it.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hm? What happened to the Temple?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: That monster blew it up.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, so that means the ceremony's over?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: And so Zumama's the Great Chief now?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Everyone was pretty shocked at first, but...

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Why did I destroy the Temple? It's simple.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: It's my way of telling you all we're ending this tradition.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: With your fists, you can beat down ten men. If you're Gavial, maybe you take a hundred. But more than that?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Even Gavial couldn't manage.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: There's a limit to what you can do with your fists.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: But with a tool? That's different. My tribe created this 'Big, Ugly Thing' that effortlessly took down Gavial and destroyed the Temple just as easily.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: This is the power of a tool.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Tools can make you all even stronger!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: And so I hereby proclaim the age of machines!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Everyone bought into it, so...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: So she became the Great Chief. Hah, well, that's an L for me, obviously.

options: You're right to accept it, Gavial.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? Yep. A loss is a loss.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey, Doctor, I don't need your comfort. I'm really fine.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hmph, duh. Do you know me?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, but I have to apologize to Tomimi. It's my fault you never got a chance to fight.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: ...That's okay. Even if I went up there, it wouldn't have changed anything.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yeah, you're right about that one.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey, Doctor, what do we do now?

options: Find the engine and the others.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Ah, right! We need the engine to get back.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: And as for the others, if we didn't see them at the ceremony, maybe they got lost?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Still thinking it over, Doctor? No rush. We've got some vacation time left.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Haha, I love this Doctor! Then let's get some sightseeing in while we look for the engine and the girls.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Erm, well...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? Those two over there...

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Hey, Yota, are you okay?!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Yeah, it's just, it kinda...

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Yota!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: I need a shaman!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey, let me take a look.

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Gavial? You're alive?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Takes more than that to kill me.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Shut up for now. Lay your brother out and I'll look him over.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Tomimi, get my medical bag.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Oh, okay!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Is he gonna be alright?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: He's not dead. But he's not looking good either.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Shortness of breath, foamy, bloody spittle... Hm? And Originium crystals on the body?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: ...Doctor, my initial diagnosis is heart failure brought on by Oripathy.

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: It's Stone Disease. The symptoms aren't too bad. I have some emergency medicine in my bag, but we need to treat him right away.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Stand him up. He can't lay down. I'll give him some oxygen.

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: The Stone Disease did this? Ugh, I told him not to push it.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey, what's your name?

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: I'm Yogi. That's my brother, Yota.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Which tribe?

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Eunectes.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: What's wrong, Gavial? Your face is scaring me.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Not now.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I'm asking again: Did Zumama send you into the mines to get ore for her big metal monster?

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Yes. Why?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I'm sorry, Doctor. No matter what, I have to pay Zumama a visit.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Nothing gets past you, Doctor.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You're the Doctor, you definitely know why.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Sorry again, Doctor. But I have to do this.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Our tribes don't have much contact with the outside world. To you and the other operators, we're a primitive backwater.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: But there is one good thing about this place. You heard it, right? They call Oripathy 'Stone Disease' and treat it like an ordinary malady.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Sometimes people catch it, sometimes they die of it. But nobody thinks it's anything special, because people here die from lots of things.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Everyone looks after Oripathy patients like they're just regular sick people. All they know about the disease is you can catch it in the mines.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: So very few people go into the mines. It's been that way for a long time.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial caught it when she saved me.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yeah. When Tomimi was little, she snuck into the depths of the mines. I went to rescue her, and I got sick.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Lucky she didn't.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: If only I got it instead...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Don't you dare say that. Getting sick is a terrible thing. It's just bad luck.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Whimper)

options: So they really ostracized you out of here?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You've asked that a couple of times, Doctor.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: After I got sick, the other tribespeople wouldn't let me do anything. I couldn't hunt, I couldn't even go to a gathering.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: And the little runt Tomimi here was the worst. She came over from her tribe and stuck to me like glue. She did everything for me, and I had nothing to do.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: In the end, they wouldn't even let me join the ceremony.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Day after day, time after time, it was 'Oh no, Gavial, let me do that for you,' you know what I mean...? That's no life for me.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial didn't smile much after that...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I was so pissed off, I went to the ceremony anyway, and beat the tar out of everyone I saw on the way.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: *Sob*, I shouldn't have been so pushy, Gavial...

options: ...That really is a kind of ostracization.
Sure wish someone would ostracize me like that!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: The reality is, around here, if you can't fight, you're nothing. A waste of space.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I'd rather you let me put myself in danger than take away my freedom to do anything.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Doctor, don't you think this is funny?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I think it's funny. Only after I left the tribe did I realize what kind of hatred people have for Oripathy sufferers.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: It took me a long time to figure that out.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Tch, watch that tongue of yours, Doctor, or I'll rip it out.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: But I know what you mean. Out there, discrimination is what you get as an Oripathy patient.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What I went through back then, though, that was still torture for me.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey, you got me off on a tangent there. This isn't what I wanted to talk about.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hmm... What was I saying?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, right.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Doctor, help me out here.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, I got it.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Bullshit.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, I got it.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I was thinking about how that great big monster of a machine must've taken a ton of iron ore to build.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Put that together with what Zumama was saying, and we know she definitely sent her people down into the mines to get that ore.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Now that you mention it, I have heard something like that.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Now I've got no problem with that, on its face. If she just had them digging around on the outside, no big deal.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: But now people are getting sick, and I have to do something.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I don't care about her age of machines or whatever. If she's throwing away lives, she's earned a clobbering.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Thanks, Doctor.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Ooh, you've got that penetrating gaze, Doctor.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hah, but of course.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Tomimi, where is Zumama's tribe?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Um, I don't know.

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Hey, Gavial, I'm really not interested in your hopes and dreams and ideals here. What's up with my brother?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? You can understand our Sargonian?

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Yes. The leader taught all of us.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: ...What is that Zumama up to?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Whatever. Anyway, Tomimi, get your minions to carry this one back to your tribe. Have Lancet-2 start treating him.

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Hey, what are you doing?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: If you want your brother to live, you'll put your trust in me.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: ...Okay then, I'll take him back with me.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh? You're not coming with me?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Ah! N-No! Of course I want to go with you, Gavial. But I have a few things that need doing first. I'll catch up with you later!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What things? Need my help?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: N-No! I can take care of it myself!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial, do you remember the great waterfall? We'll meet up there!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Alright. You're the one and only Gavial, I trust you. But I'm going with!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: No, you won't be any help. And there's something I need you to do for me.

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Go tell Zumama we need to have a talk.
